name: trading-design
tagline_zh: 做交易面板总被说丑？这套设计规范直接给你专业级配色、排版和交互细节，让用户一眼就信你的数据。
tagline_en: Trading UI looking amateur? Get pro-grade color, typography, and interaction details that make your data.
desc_en: Professional trading UI design system. Load when designing or implementing panels, layouts, typography, color, data display, or interactions for trading applications.
why_zh: 同类规范只给组件，它连数据密度、数字字体和涨跌色盲方案都替你调好了。
why_en: Others give components; this one also nails data density, tabular numerals, and colorblind-safe up/down colors.
